summary: aivpn là VPN dựa trên AI giúp traffic không thể bị Deep Packet Inspection phát hiện.
usecases: Bypassing government or corporate DPI censorship.
Securely transferring sensitive data on untrusted networks.
Protecting privacy against deep inspection by ISPs.
ideas: Integrate with obfuscation techniques like V2Ray for enhanced stealth.
